description: Set ALL parties of a contract with their role — for multi-party contracts (a married couple as two tenants, a GbR plus its property manager, a group company plus a third party). Replaces the contract's party list (rows written by the folder import are replaced too). Required: contract_id, parties [{account_id | contact_id | name, role}] with role one of vermieter, mieter, auftraggeber, auftragnehmer, verwalter, vertreter, buerge, sonstige. account_id/contact_id must belong to this tenant; a party with only a name is kept as text. The contract's main counterparty (account_id/contact_id) is NOT changed — set it with update_contract. get_contract returns the list as parties.

parties.description: All parties of the contract: [{ account_id | contact_id | name, role }]; replaces the list

name.description: Party name as text, when no account_id or contact_id is given

role.description: Role: vermieter, mieter, auftraggeber, auftragnehmer, verwalter, vertreter, buerge or sonstige

name: set_contract_parties
